script_line: I like flowers and stuff, but this place no give flavor. No gold, where's the signs, the bling-blings, come on!
Damn, Jett, have you ever considered a life of crime? I have contacts. Let me know.
Never been in a knife fight, have you?
Hell yeah! Who's up for another?
Phoenix, if you keep pulling stunts like that, you can brag as much as you like.
You've earned this win, let's make it official!
I would hate working here. You couldn't pay me to sit at a desk.
How did they think this would end?
I feel bad for them, I really do. Just not enough to stop winning.
Oh, oh dear no sweetheart! We must protect you.
Nothing stays hidden from me. Nothing.
Fade, now you're just showing off.
The greatest battles ever fought are written in storybooks. May they write about this one.
When we are at peace, I would meet you again.
Hey, who has a good song for 'we were losing but now things are looking up'? You know, like uh, redemption arc.
It is strange, Sage. Where I'm from, you're no medic, only a weapon.
Is Killjoy here? I could use some repairs.
Everyone makes fun of German efficiency, haha. Just keep laughing as you use all my gear.
I can buy, who needs what?
You think you can kill me?
Next time I'm gettin' first place!
Cypher, I'm so sorry about breaking all your stuff. I mean, I won't stop, but I am sorry.
Spend those creds before we lose them.
Focus your hate at the enemy, KAY/O, it is wasted on me.
If you've never seen a massacre, this is what it looks like.
I've stood over so many corpses. A few more, does not matter.
This poor place. It clings to life. A city after my own heart
This city is safe once more.
Strong finish. Could be even stronger.
Level heads until we're home, yes? Good.
If any of you mattered, you'd be alive.
So, you use explosives to propel yourself, Raze. That's... that's creative. I think I like it.
That's me over there! Great, now I can kick my own ass.
Spend your money now. There's no bank in hell.
